applies_to: IMI TA TA-Slider BACnet MS/TP valve actuators: 160 (incl. CO), 500 (incl. R24), 750, 1250 (discontinued 2023) and 1600 Plus and 2T, firmware 2.5.0.
summary: Digitally configurable TA-Slider valve actuators (160 N to 1600 N) with BACnet MS/TP. Over the bus they take a relative setpoint, report position, interpolated flow and two optional temperature sensors, and expose stroke/flow limits, change-over regimes, temperature limitation and an error log. The 160/500 and the 750/1250/1600 documents print the same object table, except that only the larger actuators have the second relay (BV 4).
notes: Taken from the protocol implementation tables (object, name, access, unit, value range, default, resolution) of both TA-Slider documents; footnote markers after names are removed.

Differences between the two documents: BV 4 Relay2 exists only on the 750/1250/1600; the 160/500 document prints AV 0 as "ControlSetpoint" and MSI 1 state 2 as reserved; stroke and flow ranges are model-specific.
Many objects come in SI and US pairs (µm/in, l/h/USGPM, °C/°F); read the one that matches your units.

Several limits and temperature functions only apply when the change-over regime, valve type (AV 31) or temperature limitation is configured, usually with the HyTune app and TA-Dongle. Access [RW] (relay, limited stroke) is writable only in some configurations.
Some objects need firmware 1.1.0 (main board 4.0.0), 2.4.4/2.4.5 or 2.5.0 per the footnotes; BV 3/BV 4 relays need the relay option.

source.title: TA-Slider 750/1250/1600 BACnet MS/TP Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement - PICS

integration.summary: Configure the actuator with HyTune (device ID, baud, parity) and set Signal Source to BusCom, then write the relative setpoint AV 0 and read back position, flow and the motor status. Set AV 2 if you want an error when the BMS stops sending.
integration.enable: The actuator follows AV 0 only when Signal Source (MSI 11) is BusCom; that is set with the HyTune app and TA-Dongle.
integration.heartbeat: AV 2 Cyclic control timeout (0-60 min, default 0 = off) raises a CyclicTime error if no control signal arrives within the time.
setup: Baud rate Auto (default), 9600-115200; device ID, baud and parity are set with HyTune.
Device instance defaults to a value computed from the serial number; Max_Master and Location are writable.
RS-485 termination: switched on with HyTune on the 160/500; on the 750/1250/1600 remove the jumper behind the wire connector on the communication board.
gotchas: Flow objects need the valve type defined (AV 31 or HyTune), otherwise they are meaningless.
Change-over by bus uses BV 2 (regime) and BV 3 (relay for a 6-way valve) and needs HyTune pre-configuration (FW 2.5.0+).
